identity: The copy in this package is byte-identical to the master of record (sha256 verified at this migration, 2026-10-26).
what_it_is: The piece's board scene — but unlike every scene migrations 1–11 shipped, this master of record states its own nature in its in-scene DEC block: it is a 2026-10-24 BACKFILL (JOB BOARD-SCENES-BACKFILL), built so the board plays the production file itself. Its DR-BACKFILL record: 'This HTML is a faithful reconstruction of the published short-02a two-futures MP4 (56.68s), assembled 2026-10-24 from the piece's own production data: hidden_files/short02-ab/assemble.py (A segment table), hidden_files/short02-ab/A/captions.ass (45 timed text events), the shared scene/panel image files, and the container intro (hidden_files/short02-ab/shared/intro_l2.mp4) + outro (files/container-assets/outro.mp4) joined by wrap.py with 0.4s crossfades. Faithful, not modernized... The MP4 is NOT re-rendered from this scene.' What the scene shows is therefore the published piece's staging exactly as published — container cards (Spartan Cortex intro 2.2 s; SUBSCRIBE outro 3.5 s; wm120 watermark at (36,36) over content only; content t=0 sits at published t=1.8 s), the timed chunk captions as published (the generation's proto word-animation form), and the published audio mix embedded. The clone performance lives in the audio and render layers of this package, not in this scene.
embedded_audio: The published MP4's own audio track — guide narration + music + container audio — re-encoded to MP3 at 192k (the scene's DR-AUDIO record: 'the exact mix viewers heard, incl. container audio'), embedded as a data URI. Measured at this migration: MP3, 48 kHz, stereo, 56.682667 s, 1,361,812 bytes, sha256 3fb328584ab7527a25867d2f71c4c64c35c56c47aa01ceff14adb890fbfe2fae. The CLONE audio exists in this package only in layer 4 (audio/narration.m4a, the candidate stream copy) and in the render.
decision_layer_in_scene: The scene's only decision compartment is its in-scene DEC block: a 5-record backfill block (coverage header: elements_recorded 5, elements_total 5, undecided []; every class recorded — backfill 1, script cited, visuals cited, audio 1, container 1). Its records: DR-BACKFILL (the reconstruction itself and its sources), DR-SCRIPT (the locked A script cited by path — files/short-02a-two-futures-script.md), DR-CONTAINER (Container v2 card specs), DR-TEXT (the text treatment: 'Timed chunk captions reproduced exactly as published... the proto word-animation form this generation of pieces was published with' — with the per-word DOM rebuild explicitly rejected for the backfill as a change to the published piece), DR-AUDIO (the audio embed above). These are SCENE-CONSTRUCTION records — they document how the backfill was made and cite the piece's records; they are not the piece's element inventory (that is the context audit's 16, in layer 3) and they contain NO per-word decisions. There is no word-decision container anywhere in the file (grep-verified at this migration); the plan's 131 word objects carry starts and display parameters only — no ends, no treatments (see decisions/word-decisions.json).

board_edition.note: The board's served edition does NOT byte-match the master of record: identity does NOT hold here (it held for intro-v3; it is not assumed — it was tested). Both hashes are recorded; the master of record is what this package carries.
